dogecoin.text:
@Kazeeas Dogecoin is a pump and dump scheme. It gets a high, people dump it, it tanks and people buy more to dump it.

The concern with it is if you get stuck with it and it's on the way down. It's not like other cryptocurrencies where as those are finite. Doge is infinite.

I can't believe people thought that Musk on SNL was going to boost dogecoin. SNL is a blackhole of comedy. Shit hasn't been funny in years. Dogecoin tanked and I bet they got the best ratings in recent history because of Musk.
